name: Malignant
source:
A man receives the worst news of his life, and it's only the start of his troubles. Time has become suddenly finite.
Forces beyond his control push and guide him. His thoughts are no longer his own, and all of it is directed toward Emmie, his little girl.
translation:
一个男人收到了一生中最糟糕的消息，而这仅仅是麻烦的开始。时间突然变得所剩无几。
不受他控制的力量推动、引导着他。他的思想不再属于自己，而这一切，都指向他的小女儿艾米。
